title: PPX Core Namespace Extension
description: The core namespace intentionally remains generic and cross-cutting. All core keys take values in [0.0, 1.0] with units `normalized_0_1`.

keys.description: Tendency to prefer novel over familiar options. 0.0 = strong familiarity preference; 1.0 = strong novelty preference.
General comfort with uncertainty and potential downside. Not a financial risk score.
Sensitivity to post-choice regret. High values SHOULD push systems toward safer, more reversible options.
Preferred sensory intensity across modalities (taste, scent, sound, texture).
Preferred amount of social stimulation. 0.0 = solitary-leaning; 1.0 = gregarious-leaning.
Preferred pace of decision-making. Low = deliberative; high = quick.
Comfort with under-specified or open-ended situations.
Price-awareness and willingness to trade price for quality. Not a discretionary-income measure.
Preferred depth of explanation from an agent. Low = concise; high = thorough.
Preferred depth of social conversation. Low = breadth-oriented; high = depth-oriented.

privacy_guidance.notes: Core keys are designed to be safely transferable across domains under a grant; they MUST NOT carry identifying information.
